additional_info.subject: ID0411732-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / R1 170001390] Missing Converters in DC3 CRM:01811000720
additional_info.body:
Hello Team,
I trust this email finds you in good health. We have received a technical support request from
Sparki
in your region regarding the following product:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / R1 170001390
Charger ID/Serial No.:
ERc1uR
Problem Description:
Missing Converters in DC3
As pe reported issue, kindly find below attached steps and knowledge article.
Troubleshooting Steps:
Check for any loose connections to all the power converters.
Use a multimeter to verify the input to the power converter is within the permissible range.
Identify the missing converter by their serial numbers and verify if they are powered on.
If a converter is missing or not powering on, swap it with a known working one and check if the replaced converter powers on.
Examine the power converter display for any errors or if it shows any light.
If all the above steps have been performed and the power converter still does not power on, please proceed with replacing it.Kindly follow the KA if needed.
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SICD_HW_Power Converter_Missing converters - Dynamics 365
MLFB No.
8EM5903-0AA01-0AA2 -TB1, -TB2, ... -TB15 Power Converter AC/DC 20kW
Upon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty since 3/6/2025as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer. We have already informed the customer that a regional representative will be in touch shortly.
Should you require further remote or expert support, please order it via PMD.
For additional information, please visit the Service Collaboration SharePoint. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
